title: Whether a class is practising together

steps.say: **Class practice** leads the class page because practising together is what a language programme lives on. The big figure is sessions run this week.
The line under it gives how long ago the last session was, and the running total of hours and sessions the class has practised together.
A class that has never played together says so plainly, and names the teacher's **Play as class** button as the thing that starts the first one.
steps.terminal: That's the class's own pulse, ahead of anything students do alone. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
